snippet.title: Shards of Order - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam page: https://tinyurl.com/shardsRD

Shards of Order, our grimdark RPG where nothing stays dead, is launching July 28, 2026.

Set out on the journey to restore the shattered Order, piece by piece. Master card-based combat, redefined. No turns. No mana. One shared deck for the whole party.

Watch the date reveal trailer, play the demo now, and wishlist on Steam!
